title: Domain Events
description: Learn domain events and event handlers.

data.text: Domain events represent something that happened in the domain. They enable loose coupling between domain logic and side effects.

terms.definition: An event that represents a domain fact.
Code that reacts to a domain event.
Middleware that routes events to handlers.
An action that happens as a result of an event (email, notification).

data.text: Domain events capture domain facts. For example, OrderPlaced is a domain event. Other parts of the system can react to it without the order service knowing about them.
Event handlers react to events. They can be in the same service (for side effects) or in other services (for integration).

items: Include all necessary data in the event

data.definition:
flowchart TD
    Order[Order Service] -->|OrderPlaced| Bus[(Event Bus)]
    Bus --> Handler1[Email Handler]
    Bus --> Handler2[Inventory Handler]
    Bus --> Handler3[Analytics Handler]
    Handler1 --> Email[Send Email]
    Handler2 --> Inventory[Reserve Stock]
    Handler3 --> Analytics[Update Dashboard]

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Domain events enable loose coupling and extensibility.
